decider: Astra under explicit user delegation; root reviews implementation and canonical contract application
scope: CE implementation target and same-path shared-core convention for EE; not an EE migration or behavior-equivalence certification.
authority: Immutable freeze input and rationale. Once applied, canonical ArchKeel contract packages own target selectors. This file is not a second live contract and is not itself an ArchKeel contract.

decisions.title: Canonical target is future physical ownership
decisions.decision: Use future packages selectors in the existing ArchKeel contract schema. Delete root COMP-PYTHON-API, interfaces forwarding components and CE DSL-CONTRACTS component. Diagrams read those contracts directly. Keep original manifest/review/observation immutable as historical source evidence. Missing future paths are pending/failing migration, never green. No target_packages or parallel target_components field.

decisions.title: Setup means ordered declarations, not eager initialization
decisions.decision: Use setup in all three DSL layers for setup/client/include/generator/state_machine/demographics declarations. Runtime GeneratorTask and StateMachineTask belong tasks/setup. Keep descriptor execution order, optional CE generator caching and Include reentry into Setup or GenIter. Definitions after Generate remain after Generate.

decisions.title: Keep actual value and flow families
decisions.decision: Keep variable binding modes together. Put KeyVariableTask directly in tasks/values as shared base. Keep branches/loops/commands aggregates, including Execute at nested-row scope. ElementModel retains grammar/schema identity under values/scalar; ModelUtil becomes model/validation.py. No model/base wrapper.

decisions.title: IO owns source policy; Runtime resolves execution inputs
decisions.decision: Runtime sources resolves expressions, root defaults, statement identity, cache keys and seed derivation into typed IO requests. IO data_sources owns family dispatch, count/read/page, distribution, uniqueness, cyclic windows and pool lifetime. No Context/Statement reaches IO. Keep domain numeric algorithms in Domains. This overturns the audit assessment's Runtime-selection recommendation; EE data_sources is the leading boundary, not a perfect implementation to copy blindly.

decisions.title: Global increment is Runtime state
decisions.decision: Move GlobalIncrementGenerator into tasks/values/construction/global_increment.py and its existing GlobalIncrementRegistry state class into storage/global_increment.py. Both Context and generator depend on storage; Context must not import tasks for its truthful registry annotation. Runtime construction/capabilities register the existing name. Remove it from Domains builtin inventory. Preserve per-root key/counter/reset, collision behavior and DSL spelling. No generic context interface in Domains.

decisions.title: Move neutral generator contracts out of DSL
decisions.decision: Move EntityValue into engine/io/contracts.py: it is the ABC consumed by IO entity serialization and implemented by BaseEntity. Move StateTransitionRule and GeneratorCapability into domain_core/contracts/generation.py. DSL StateMachineStatement uses the same plain tuple[str, str, float] shape rather than importing Domains for an alias. Move describe_generator_type into domains/registry/generators.py. Remove the vacated CE DSL contracts module and old DSL API exports; no shims. Keep executable BaseEntity at domain_core/base_entity.py. Domains may import canonical DSL vocabulary enum leaves directly, never high dsl.api or model/parser/statement implementation. This preserves a one-way Domains -> IO -> DSL dependency rather than creating a root cycle.

decisions.title: Dissolve StatementUtil by behavior
decisions.decision: Source-entity fallback functions accept scalar values in IO/data_sources/boundary/entities.py; target entity/metadata resolution in IO/exporters/core/routing.py; consumer string grammar in DSL/statements/generation/targets.py. Preserve SQL/mem source_entity->type->name; Mongo source_entity->type without name; output target_entity->type->name; file basename behavior. Runtime passes resolved fields, not Statements, into IO.

decisions.title: Preserve credentials semantics while moving IO
decisions.decision: Supply one typed on-demand property-loader callable from runtime document composition into parsing; the parser calls it at the same credential-fulfilment point. IO/connection_config/properties.py owns profile lookup/load; parsers/base/client_config.py owns descriptor merge, below setup parsers to avoid base/setup cycles. The IO loader may use the low-level parsers/input/properties.py syntax reader, not concrete DSL parsing. Preserve truthy env_props alias/mutation, conditional environment+system load, descriptor-dir then cwd then home/datamimic fallback, env overwrite, and static include sibling order. Do not eagerly preload every profile. EE descriptor-wins precedence is explicitly deferred semantic alignment, not part of structural acceptance.

decisions.title: Composition above recursive primitives
decisions.decision: Parser base owns dispatch mechanism only, registry.py concrete composition, document descriptor orchestration. Lower XML/property syntax helpers live parsers/input, not document. Task registry.py owns concrete Statement-to-Task registration; base/dispatch.py lookup only. Entry composition initializes each registry once before use; standalone supported parser/task callers still work.

decisions.title: Preserve real TaskUtil invariants, delete forwarding
decisions.decision: Move boolean condition validation into scripting/evaluation.py (missing condition true; nonbool rejected). Existing dispatch/source-template/interpolation calls directly replace forwarding. Converter construction and scalar generation belong values/construction; hierarchical export ordering belongs generate/export_order.py. IO registry owns construction, concrete dispatch and smoke execution; core owns scalar routing/target-argument parsing and serialization. Retain IO-owned ExporterContext only at registry composition, with base Exporter return type; scalar-only ExporterConfig replaces its retained context and the fake smoke context. Moving smoke into registry removes a diagnostics/registry cycle. No GenerateStatement or Runtime type dependency enters IO. Do not add methods merely to replace old utility names.

decisions.title: Break statement cycle at the specialized traversal
decisions.decision: Move root-Generate, named descendant and executed-branch queries into statements/traversal.py, importing concrete Generate/Condition and base. Remove Generate-specific type guards/virtual traversal from base Statement/CompositeStatement; retain their actual tree state. Preserve Condition executed-set iteration and branch registration, full-name lookup, deep includes, and None/error behavior. Not a TYPE_CHECKING-only fix.

decisions.title: Treat root/base context as a closed hierarchy
decisions.decision: Co-locate Context and SetupContext in contexts/context.py, migrate imports and remove setup_context.py. Explicitly retain two classes and responsibilities on the diagram; about 800 lines is reviewed cohesion debt, not decoupling or a green-check trick. expression_globals accepts explicit seeded flag/RNG/lazy Faker dependencies and does not import Context. Preserve unseeded short circuit, lazy Faker initialization and RNG draws. No 53-property protocol mirror.

decisions.title: Remove import-only interface layers
decisions.decision: Delete interfaces/api.py, interfaces/contracts.py and factory/factory_config.py forwarding modules; migrate every caller/test/doc directly to canonical runtime or authoring entries. Python factory becomes interfaces/python/factory.py. No deprecated alias modules. Preserve real facade behavior and public result contracts rather than blanket facade removal.

decisions.title: Authoring retains observable contracts
decisions.decision: Keep CompilePlan within authoring/contracts.py because ScaffoldResult exposes it. Keep contracts/spec/domain in one semantic domain aggregate: DTOs depend on diagnostic/spec types and intent rules consume plans, so a separate contracts component creates a needless component cycle. No source merge or internal DTO copy. Retain derived_facts in Domain: its semantic counts, memstore relationships and foreign-key facts are consumed by DM408 and application result assembly. Astra corrected the initial projection assignment, which would create Domain -> Projection -> Domain. Expose only derive_facts; do not widen Domain dependencies or duplicate derivation. Preserve CE persisted intent semantics and EE transaction semantics; shared physical layering is not permission to change either product contract.

decisions.title: Domains retain useful aggregates and real facade
decisions.decision: Keep domain_core shared dataset infrastructure; keep shared families and vertical models/generators/services. Keep domains/facade.py sibling to api.py, registry entities/schema/metadata above concrete services. Identity family remains grouped; seven is a review trigger, not quota. Generator->model forbidden; lazy model->generator allowed. Keep StateTransitionGenerator domain algorithm distinct from its setup definition.

decisions.title: Physical moves must preserve packaged resources
decisions.decision: Keep domain_data and schemas as data under their existing shared resource owner. Replace relocation-sensitive __file__ assumptions with stable package-resource lookup at the loader, preserving explicit environment/start override behavior and fallback policy. DbUnit belongs exporter formats (flat XML), not database transport. Keep runnable Python examples in resources/examples; do not add them to demo discovery or invent an examples facade.

decisions.title: No packaging scaffolding or new compatibility layer
decisions.decision: Use namespace support already enabled by packaging for new grouping directories. Retain meaningful __init__ exports/composition only; never add empty markers just for reports. Astra corrected the dotenv relocation after tracing MCP defaults/auth and standalone dataset entrypoints: retain the existing root load_dotenv bootstrap unchanged, once per normal package import with override=False. Moving the call changes caller-relative lookup and delays environment loading; forcing standalone Domains through Runtime would introduce the wrong dependency. Lifecycle/config keeps Settings and its distinct cwd env_file behavior. No new bootstrap wrapper or flag. Root errors stay stable; vendor DB error translation belongs IO. No EE Rust/runtime-config subsystem imported.

decisions.title: Boundary exceptions must be exact and truthful
decisions.decision: Retain Path, datetime, Random, Traversable, Pydantic strict primitives, lxml element and schema-value types. Permit only reviewed function/position pairs, not entire APIs. Astra corrected the initial class-return proposal after tracing heterogeneous constructors: rename the existing lookup to get_entity_service_factory with Callable[..., BaseDomainService] | None; retain EntitySpec.service_cls: type[BaseDomainService] for class discovery. No extra wrapper, local type-erasure alias or private Runtime import. Explicit DSL keywords reach the concrete constructor unchanged; only injected options are signature-filtered. Keep type[BaseModel] factory and constrained zero-argument value suppliers. Recompute final UNKNOWN results; allowances record scoped intentional opacity, not deeper type proof.

final_dependency_amendment.decision: Merge existing RandomSource Protocol and cumulated_index into the real neutral leaf randomness.py. Moving source selection into IO would otherwise create IO -> Domains -> IO. Domain numeric generators, IO selection and Runtime may depend on these exact primitives; no wrappers, duplicated distribution math, new folder or broad shared utility package. Keep generation algorithms, seed lifecycle and deterministic clocks at their existing owners.

deferred_semantic_alignment.decision: Preserve CE behavior for structural migration. EE descriptor-wins vs CE environment-wins requires an explicit later semantic change, not target completion.
deferred_semantic_alignment.required_evidence: Same conflicting descriptor/environment/profile fixtures on both editions, explicit expected winner and migration note before changing CE.

verification_limits: Static source/contract decision; not a second exhaustive source audit or executed equivalence suite.
EE inspected read-only in current checkout; no claim that EE already satisfies target or that its behavior should blindly replace CE.
Historical baseline stays unchanged; zero structural violations alone is not implementation acceptance.
